paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.70% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+4.92%) and Hang Seng weakest (-1.60%). Brent crude changed +1.79% to 104.14. Gold changed -1.44% to 4,141.7998. Bitcoin changed -4.21% to 81,199.0625. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.269%, a relative move of +0.61%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (-7.55%) and Carlyle (-6.31%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Germany blocks Chinese acquisition in its largest seaport (FT World). Berlin rejects state-owned Cosco’s takeover of a Hamburg port logistics group ‘on security concerns’ Deals and capital markets: Starbucks has explored takeover of Chipotle in restaurant megadeal (FT World). Purchase of $41bn market-value burrito chain would rank as largest restaurant acquisition of all time Central banks and macro: Iran war blows near-£12bn hole in Britain’s public finances (FT World). FT estimates show inflation and soaring borrowing costs have slashed chancellor John Healey’s headroom in half Central banks and macro: French central bank chief says ECB intervention not needed to ease bond rout (FT World). Emmanuel Moulin also hit out at ‘Trump-style’ threats against him from the far-left Geopolitics and trade: Oil majors target Middle East despite war disruption (FT Markets). Western groups seek new investment opportunities despite chaos and heightened risks caused by conflict with Iran
